numerics.initial_step_reason: Uniform mesh with continuous forcing; explicit small initial step retained from the original uniform setup.

classification: Prescribed virtual gas and radiation reservoirs; equilibrium reaction limit with physically separate inner/outer ledgers

scope: Independent new ramp scenario; it does not replace or qualify the unresolved original step-boundary spatial experiment. Equilibrium chemistry and virtual transport only.

domain.geometry_classification: Virtual 2cm fixed-volume planar column, sealed left and one open right surface.

transport.source_note: No material measurement; Onsager supplies near-equilibrium response structure only; finite force use is an explicit constitutive extension.

state_order: Per-cell [ln(C/Ca), ln(N2/Nref), U], followed by original ten exterior ledgers
surface_geometry: Uniform planar widths; internal center distance dx and outer half-cell distance dx/2.

Preserve that complete record and extend the cooling phase to 12000s before any multi-cell spatial trajectory; physical coefficients and all event/accuracy thresholds are unchanged.

initial_reservoir_basis.note: Match initial virtual gas pressure/composition and temperature; subsequent knots are prescribed virtual choices, not measured kiln operation.
